A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets, shoes, gloves .. etc
Turbine must be shut down
Fuel system ( solar gas ) of gas turbine out of service
Isolate the step-up transformer and it's circuit breaker

Isolate the circuit breaker of all pump motors and disconnect the electrical 
terminal of all pump motors
Fire fighting system must be out of service
Complete maintenance tool set
Basket
Crane 25 ton
Dismantle the domed cover 03 including burner and swirl.

The crane cables are attached to the three support hooks 06 and the basket 
 07 is lowered into the combustion chamber

Inspect the combustion chamber tiles (finned segments) if it is not good ( 
 it have a big wear ) it must by changed.
To change the combustion chamber tiles ( finned segments ) see fig. 2.

Remove all six plates 01 on the swirl guide 02, do not dismantle swirl 
 guide.
Disassemble the tow upper sight glass connection tubes 04.

The basket 07 attached to the over head crane and lowered into the 
 combustion chamber until the upper ring of the basket is slightly below 
 the finned segment carrier 05 which is to by lifted out and replace the 
 bad tile ( bad finned segment)

After changing the bad tile install finned segment carrier 05 in its 
 position.
Install the two upper sight glass connection tube 04.
Install all six plates 01on the swirl guide 02.
Install the domed cover 03 including burner and swirl.

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed 
every 2000 equivalent operating hours EOH as indicated in the title block
The combustion chamber tiles prevent the temperature from arrival to combustion 
chamber

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets, shoes, gloves .. etc
Turbine must be shut down
Fuel system ( solar gas ) of gas turbine out of service
Isolate the step-up transformer and it's circuit breaker
Isolate the circuit breaker of all pump motors and disconnect the electrical 
terminal of all pump motors
Fire fighting system must be out of service
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set
Basket
Crane 25 ton
Work to be Carried Out
Dismantle the domed cover 03 including burner and swirl.
The crane cables are attached to the three support hooks 06 and the basket 
 07 is lowered into the combustion chamber
Inspect the combustion chamber tiles (finned segments) if it is not good ( 
 it have a big wear ) it must by changed.
To change the combustion chamber tiles ( finned segments ) see fig. 2.
Remove all six plates 01 on the swirl guide 02, do not dismantle swirl 
 guide.
Disassemble the tow upper sight glass connection tubes 04.
The basket 07 attached to the over head crane and lowered into the 
 combustion chamber until the upper ring of the basket is slightly below 
 the finned segment carrier 05 which is to by lifted out and replace the 
 bad tile ( bad finned segment)
After changing the bad tile install finned segment carrier 05 in its 
 position.
Install the two upper sight glass connection tube 04.
Install all six plates 01on the swirl guide 02.
Install the domed cover 03 including burner and swirl.
